description.zh: 应用ID，通过控制台创建和查询，仅支持传单个ID。
description.en: Application ID. You can create and query this ID in the console. Only a single ID is supported.

title.en: Query the AppKey of a specified application

descriptions.zh:
### 使用说明
调用本接口前，您必须已经在RTC控制台创建了应用。
### QPS限制
本接口的单用户QPS限制为200次/分钟。超过限制，API调用会被限流，这可能会影响您的业务，请合理调用。
descriptions.en:
### How-To  
Before invoking this API, you must have already created an application in the RTC console.  
### queries per second (QPS) limit  
The QPS limit for this API is 200 requests per minute per user. If the limit is exceeded, API calls will be subject to Rate Limiting, which may Impact your business. Please invoke the API appropriately.
